title: Erika FS NDE 2591
content: My first experience happened very fast, but was very significant. What happened was that I fell off a wash basin when I was six years old and struck my head on a heater that was inside the bathroom. At the same time, a full water glass that was on a shelf broke between the floor and my head. The only thing I remember is that I saw a pathway of stones and I walked along it with someone who took me by my hand. We went towards a resplendent light. I wasn't afraid at any time. I didn't see the face of the person I was walking with, nevertheless he wore a white tunic and I walked on his left. Suddenly, I heard my mother's voice and turned back and then I woke up. My second experience happened when I heard a song that is precisely the theme of the movie, 'Casablanca.' The first time I heard this song I felt a strange sensation in my body. My heart began to beat rapidly and I felt as if my body was full of cuts. Afterwards I had a vision of a highway where I saw a crumpled, pistachio green automobile - so crumpled; in fact, I remember it looked like an accordion. I saw two bodies thrown there (I saw everything from above), covered with blood. I supposed the bodies were dead. But first I felt that sensation of my heart beating rapidly and above all else, my body hurt all over and I felt like I had cuts in my skin. That time I cried. Background Information: Gender: Female Date NDE Occurred: En el año de 1980 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? Yes Accident Direct head injury Life threatening event, but not clinical death One of the experiences was caused by a life-threatening event. How do you consider the content of your experience? Frightening Did you feel separated from your body? Yes I lost awareness of my body How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? Less consciousness and alertness than normal During the second occasion, I felt a lot of fear and my heart suddenly beat rapidly. My whole body hurt and I had great desire to cry. At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? I wasn't in a conscience state during the second experience. I was afraid during the second occasion. I didn't feel fear during the first. Were your thoughts speeded up? Incredibly fast Did time seem to speed up or slow down? Time seemed to go faster than usual Were your senses more vivid than usual? More so than usual Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. Well, at age six, I hadn't lived through many experiences. I had never before suffered an accident. My first automobile accident was when I was nineteen and not with the same intensity that I experienced. Please compare your hearing during the experience to your everyday hearing that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. I'm deaf in one ear. Nevertheless, I don't know for sure if I lost my hearing because of the accident in the bathroom. Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere? Neither Did you pass into or through a tunnel? No Did you see any beings in your experience? Neither Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? Uncertain I held somebody's hand, but I don't know who it was. Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? Neither Did you see an unearthly light? Yes Very white and resplendent. Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? Unfamiliar, strange place What emotions did you feel during the experience? With the first experience I didn't feel fear. With the second, I recall feeling it. Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? Incredible peace or pleasantness Did you have a feeling of joy? Neither Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? United, one with the world Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? Everything about the universe Did scenes from your past come back to you? Neither Did scenes from the future come to you? From personal future Did you come to a border or point of no return? Neither God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Moderate Have your religious practices changed since your experience? No What is your religion now? Moderate Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? No Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? Definite being, or voice clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin Did you see deceased or religious spirits? Neither Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? No Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? No After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? Uncertain They are two different experiences - nevertheless, they both happened at the same age, although at different stages. Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? No Have you ever shared this experience with others? Yes I didn't know what had happened to me until I found out about the tunnels of light. Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? No What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was probably real What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? No Are there any other questions that we could ask to help you communicate your experience? I'm not yet familiar with this website. Nevertheless I enjoy it and hope to continue visiting it.

arrival.other_being_detail: A person whose face was not seen, wearing a white tunic, held her hand as they walked toward the light.

environment.environment_other_detail: A pathway of stones; described as an unfamiliar, strange place.

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: Heard her mother's voice, turned back, and then woke up.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Fell off a wash basin at age six and struck her head on a heater in the bathroom; glass broke between the floor and her head.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Second experience: bodily sensations triggered by hearing the 'Casablanca' theme, followed by a vision of a crumpled pistachio-green car and two bloody bodies seen from above.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: First: stone path with an unseen companion toward a resplendent light, then hearing mother's voice and waking. Second: fear/physical sensations then an above-view vision of an accident scene.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Second experience appears as a music-triggered vision with bodily pain sensations and an above-view of an automobile crash scene with two bloody bodies.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I saw a pathway of stones and I walked along it with someone who took me by my hand. We went towards a resplendent light.”
